items.title: Visa and Mastercard Face Potential £5bn UK Group Claim Over Interchange Fees
items.summary: According to The Guardian, law firms have applied to the Competition Appeal Tribunal to launch a group claim seeking compensation for UK businesses allegedly overcharged on card payments.

items.title: Ohio Judge Strikes Down Legislative Attempt to Repeal Clean Air Rule
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, a Franklin County judge has blocked a state law that aimed to eliminate Ohio's air nuisance regulations, ruling that the repeal violated the state constitution's single-subject rule.

items.title: Symetra and TIAA launch Mariner Re with $750m investment
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, symetra Life Insurance Company and TIAA have established Mariner Re, a Class E-licensed reinsurer in Bermuda supported by a major equity backing.

items.title: Allianz UK launches comprehensive renewable technology insurance cover
items.summary: According to Commercial Risk, allianz UK has expanded its renewable energy offerings with a single operational policy covering multiple clean energy and grid-stabilisation technologies.

items.title: Anthropic IPO reveals AI existential risk disclosures as UK financial sector adoption rises
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, aI developer Anthropic has filed its IPO prospectus highlighting potential catastrophic risks, arriving as UK regulators confirm widespread financial sector adoption.

items.title: Chancellor Healey unveils pre-Budget cost-of-living relief package
items.summary: According to BBC, john Healey has announced plans to drop import taxes on more than 100 products as part of a package of everyday fixes ahead of the Budget.
